decision.explanation: The question asks for the division(s) of the '1978 college football season'. Source D1S1 explicitly states that the 1978 NCAA Division I-A football season was the first season of Division I-A, created in 1978 when Division I was subdivided. Source D3S1 explicitly describes the 1978 NCAA Division III football season as part of college football organized at the Division III level. Since the 1978 season included multiple subdivisions (I-A, I-AA, and III), both 'NCAA Division I-A' and 'NCAA Division III' are valid, distinct answers representing different parts of the overall season structure mentioned in the sources. Other divisions like II, IV, etc., are not supported by the provided text.
